name: Sunthread drive Mk I
description: A slim drive that burns clean and quiet. It spins up faster than a human drive twice its weight.

name: Sunthread drive Mk II
description: Mk II retunes the lattice so the flame runs a little hotter and a little whiter.

name: Sunthread drive Mk III
description: The third retuning of the Sunthread. House engineers say it hums a half-tone higher.

name: Wisp drive Mk I
description: A twin-vane drive for light hulls. It trades a robust casing for a lot less mass.

name: Wisp drive Mk II
description: The vanes are rewoven for a sharper burn. Handle it gently on the pad.

name: Wisp drive Mk III
description: Gold-filament coils replace the silver, and the thrust climbs accordingly.

name: Swiftbough drive Mk I
description: A mid-weight drive cut from a single grown crystal core, as the old houses made them.

name: Swiftbough drive Mk II
description: A refined Swiftbough with a tighter exhaust cone and a thinner housing.

name: Swiftbough drive Mk III
description: The finest Swiftbough a house will sell outside its own kin.

name: Gatebreath drive Mk I
description: A long-throat drive for large hulls. Elegant, and a good deal lighter than it looks.

name: Gatebreath drive Mk II
description: Resonance rings reduce the shudder at full burn. Still not for rough docking.

name: Gatebreath drive Mk III
description: Its exhaust is nearly colourless at full burn, which some captains find unsettling.

name: Skyloom drive Mk I
description: A great slender drive for the long freight-sails of the houses. It takes a breath before it answers.

name: Skyloom drive Mk II
description: Reworked ring spacing gives a cleaner thrust curve across the burn.

name: Skyloom drive Mk III
description: A house heirloom pattern, built to order and rarely replaced.

name: Dawncell plant Mk I
description: A palm-sized solar cell that drinks starlight and gives back six pips.

name: Dawncell plant Mk II
description: Mk II widens the collector petals. Capacitor charge returns noticeably faster in sunlight.

name: Dawncell plant Mk III
description: A third-generation Dawncell, still no heavier than a sealed book.

name: Lightwell plant Mk I
description: A bloom of thin collector fins around a small core. Quick to charge, quick to run dry.

name: Lightwell plant Mk II
description: Finer fins and a better-cooled core. Houses fit it to couriers and explorers.

name: Lightwell plant Mk III
description: The collector fins are gilded to shed heat, which is also why it costs so much.

name: Starbloom plant Mk I
description: A medium plant for gunships and long-range hulls. Its collectors fold flat under fire.

name: Starbloom plant Mk II
description: The core now holds a bigger charge before it sheds the excess.

name: Starbloom plant Mk III
description: Tuned by a Selune artisan and priced like it.

name: Heliarch plant Mk I
description: A broad solar array wrapped round a slim core. Mind the fins when docking.

name: Heliarch plant Mk II
description: A steadier core and better heat paths. Recharge is generous in bright systems.

name: Heliarch plant Mk III
description: Its petals track the nearest star on their own, without being asked.

name: Sunheart plant Mk I
description: The great plant of the freight-sails. Vast, pale and surprisingly light.

name: Sunheart plant Mk II
description: A revised core keeps the sail-load steady across long hauls.

name: Sunheart plant Mk III
description: A plant that charges from the faintest star. The old houses called it patience made solid.

name: Veilglass Mk I
description: A thin film of woven light. It recovers quickly but holds little.

name: Veilglass Mk II
description: A tighter weave. It still breaks early and still returns early.

name: Veilglass Mk III
description: A third weave from the Tirael looms; it recovers almost before the hit has stopped ringing.

name: Mirrorveil Mk I
description: A twin-layer veil for small ships. Quick to rebuild, soon exhausted.

name: Mirrorveil Mk II
description: The outer layer is lengthened to shed glancing fire.

name: Mirrorveil Mk III
description: A fine veil, and a costly one. Heavy weapons go through it rather easily.

name: Silverfall Mk I
description: A falling curtain of light fed by a slim emitter ring.

name: Silverfall Mk II
description: Better emitter spacing gives it more depth and a shorter pause before recovery.

name: Silverfall Mk III
description: The ring is cut with a house crest; it does nothing for the shield but captains like it.

name: Aegis of Dawn Mk I
description: A great curved screen of pale light. It shrugs off small fire and nothing bigger.

name: Aegis of Dawn Mk II
description: A refined screen with a faster recharge between volleys.

name: Aegis of Dawn Mk III
description: Built for houses that expect to be shot at only rarely and politely.

name: Lanternward Mk I
description: A broad lantern-shaped field that spreads the load over a wide surface.

name: Lanternward Mk II
description: The field is retuned to refill briskly once the shooting stops.

name: Lanternward Mk III
description: The largest veil the houses build, and the thinnest for its size.

name: Listening glass Mk I
description: A small crystal lens that hears the faint song of other ships' drives.

name: Listening glass Mk II
description: A sharper lens grown on a cooler cut.

name: Listening glass Mk III
description: The lens has been polished by hand, which accounts for the price.

name: Far-seeing lens Mk I
description: A paired-lens suite that reaches well past what its size suggests.

name: Far-seeing lens Mk II
description: A wider aperture and a calmer filter.

name: Far-seeing lens Mk III
description: Resolves a lit window at the far end of a system, or so the house claims.

name: Starcaller array Mk I
description: A latticework dish of silver ribs. It sees much and survives little.

name: Starcaller array Mk II
description: The ribs are doubled and the filter retuned for deep-system work.

name: Starcaller array Mk III
description: Houses say it can tell a gate's mood from three jumps off.

name: Willow rack
description: Slatted racks that fold down when empty, light and tidy.

name: Reed hold
description: A woven hold of pale composite, strong for its weight and no more.

name: Lantern hold
description: A lit, ventilated bay for goods the houses would rather not see crushed.

name: Long hold
description: A slender hold running the keel, with a rail for house-sealed crates.

name: Grand hold
description: A broad hold of pale ribs, packed with careful ceremony.

name: Lance Mk I
description: A fine, fast bolt that flies true to long range. It needs a steady hand.

name: Lance Mk II
description: Mk II tightens the focus again, and the bolt lands where it was aimed.

name: Lance Mk III
description: The best lance a house will sell to a stranger.

name: Twin Lance Mk I
description: A two-barrel lance for light gunships. Each shot is crisp and cheap.

name: Twin Lance Mk II
description: Longer barrels, slightly harder bolts.

name: Twin Lance Mk III
description: A drawn-out lance with a pale gold muzzle ring.

name: Grand Lance Mk I
description: A heavy lance that fires a bolt the length of an arm. It scarcely needs to lead a target.

name: Grand Lance Mk II
description: A heavy lance with improved focus crystals.

name: Grand Lance Mk III
description: A house duelling-lance scaled up for ships. Its report is almost musical.

name: Prism emitter Mk I
description: A faceted emitter that scatters its light into a rapid stream. Short range, easy on power.

name: Prism emitter Mk II
description: Cleaner facets and a hotter flash.

name: Prism emitter Mk III
description: The facets are cut in threes, so the stream sings as it fires.

name: Twin Prism emitter Mk I
description: A bigger prism with a spun mount. It sprays fast and sips energy.

name: Twin Prism emitter Mk II
description: A re-cut prism with a narrower beam.

name: Twin Prism emitter Mk III
description: Its stream throws coloured shadows across the hull at close range.

name: Grand Prism emitter Mk I
description: A full prism cluster for gunships. It chews through shields at close quarters.

name: Grand Prism emitter Mk II
description: A tuned cluster with better heat paths.

name: Grand Prism emitter Mk III
description: A house heirloom pattern that costs more than the ship that carries it should.

name: Sunthread caster Mk I
description: A slow caster that spins a single bright thread of light across great distances.

name: Sunthread caster Mk II
description: The thread is tighter and carries further.

name: Sunthread caster Mk III
description: Each shot takes a breath to gather. The house calls this restraint.

name: Twin Sunthread caster Mk I
description: A slow, heavy thread that reaches very far and hurts a good deal on arrival.

name: Twin Sunthread caster Mk II
description: A steadier gather and a longer reach.

name: Twin Sunthread caster Mk III
description: Fires like a held note, and lands like a closed door.

name: Grand Sunthread caster Mk I
description: A gunship caster that draws on the plant for every shot. It is formidable and demanding.

name: Grand Sunthread caster Mk II
description: Improved gather coils shorten the pause between shots.

name: Grand Sunthread caster Mk III
description: The great sunthread of the old line-ships, rebuilt for modern hulls.

name: Solar sail
description: A gossamer sail that unfolds in open space. Adds starlight recharge but folds away in combat.

name: Great solar sail
description: A wider sail with gold-thread edging. It charges well near a bright star and tears easily.

name: Gate resonator
description: A tuned crystal that listens for gate harmonics. It shortens the approach to a gate and says nothing about how.

name: Songlens
description: A small lens that picks out ship signatures a little earlier. The elves hear it as a note, and so can you if you stand still.
